## What changed

Describe the focused change.

## Why

Explain the user, data, or maintenance problem it addresses.

## Verification

List the checks or evidence used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials or local artifacts.
- [ ] Tests and documentation were updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Data or model changes include reproducible evidence.
- [ ] Observed values, forecasts, and user assumptions remain clearly separated.
